finding: Although there was no direct association between mode of delivery and postpartum depression, emergency cesarean section and vacuum extraction were indirectly associated with an increased risk of postpartum depression through postpartum complications, self-reported physical symptoms postpartum, and therefore a negative delivery experience
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section and vacuum extraction were indirectly associated with an increased risk of postpartum depression, by leading to postpartum complications, self-reported physical symptoms postpartum, and therefore a negative delivery experience
